title: THE BLACK SUN INCURSION
description: An extraterrestrial dreadnought fleet under the command of Null Void has enveloped the upper atmosphere of Metro Nova, threatening to trigger a permanent dark matter eclipse!
loreHeadline: COSMIC ANOMALY COVERS SKY: MAYOR DECLARES MARTIAL LAW

rewards.commemorativeBadge: 🌟 Savior of the Black Sun Crossover

stages.name: Stage I: Downtown Civilian Evacuation & Shield Defenses
stages.description: Evacuate 500 pinned civilians from collapsing skyscrapers and establish hard-light perimeter shields.

stages.name: Stage II: Dismantle the Dark Tachyon Generators
stages.description: Raid the subterranean energy nodes powering the orbital invasion beam.

stages.name: Stage III: Alliance Orbital Flagship Strike (Climax)
stages.description: Board the Dreadnought flagship with your alliance team and defeat Null Void in an epic showdown!

title: PROJECT GORGONNET: NANITE PLAGUEWAVE
description: Cyber-Gorgon has transmitted an infectious neural virus across the municipal smart-grid, converting city police mechs and transit trains into autonomous kill-bots.
loreHeadline: ROGUE AUTOMATED DEFENSES TURN AGAINST CIVILIANS

stages.name: Stage I: Neutralize Infected Mech Patrols
stages.description: Defeat 4 rogue cybernetic heavy drones rampaging through the Neon District.

stages.name: Stage II: Upload EMP Firewall to Central Mainframe
stages.description: Infiltrate Aero-Tech Park and upload the countermeasures.

stages.name: Stage III: Confront Cyber-Gorgon Prime at the Apex Core
stages.description: Engage Cyber-Gorgon in the heart of the infected supercomputer chamber.
